{"id":1933904008,"question_id":4013,"lang":"cpp","lang_name":"C++","time":"4 months, 3 weeks","timestamp":1772297232,"status":10,"status_display":"Accepted","runtime":"4 ms","url":"/submissions/detail/1933904008/","is_pending":"Not Pending","title":"Merge Close Characters","memory":"9.5 MB","code":"class Solution {\npublic:\n    string mergeCharacters(string s, int k) {\n        unordered_map<char , int>mp;\n        string ans = \"\";\n\n        int index = 0;\n        for(int i = 0 ; i<s.size(); i++)\n        {\n            int curr_pos = index;\n            if(mp.count(s[i]))\n            {\n                int last_pos = mp[s[i]];\n                if(curr_pos - last_pos <= k) continue;\n            } \n            mp[s[i]] = index;\n            index++;\n            ans.push_back(s[i]);\n        }\n    return ans;\n    }\n};","compare_result":"","title_slug":"merge-close-characters","has_notes":false,"flag_type":1,"frontend_id":1751}
